description: This file contains implementation of scientific calculator functions, including mathematical operations (sin, cos, tan, log, factorial, etc.), error handling, and utility functions within the CalcEngine namespace. It defines the CCalcEngine class methods SciCalcFunctions and DisplayError, handling complex mathematical computations and error reporting.

classes.name: CCalcEngine
classes.description: Main class implementing calculator functions and error handling within the CalcEngine namespace.

methods.name: SciCalcFunctions
methods.description: Performs various scientific calculator functions based on the operation code, including trigonometric, logarithmic, factorial, and angle conversions.

methods.name: DisplayError
methods.description: Displays an error message based on the error code and sets the error flag.
